description: The Packed Bubble Chart is a variation of the bubble chart that displays data in a circular packed layout. The chart consists of different sized bubbles, arranged into one overall area. Each bubble in the Packed Bubble Chart represents a data point, and its size corresponds to the value of that data point. The bubbles are positioned evenly around the area. The Packed Bubble Chart is particularly useful when comparing multiple categories or data points simultaneously. It allows users for easy identification of the highest or lowest values and enables users to quickly discern patterns or trends within the dataset. Packed Bubble Chart offers customization options for multiple visual aspects.
